subject.title: fix(repair): publish only validated target commits

question: Should repair execution adopt this Linux namespace and Landlock ABI 3 fail-closed boundary as the permanent supported-runner contract after exact-head hosted proof?
rationale: The code review can assess implementation defects, but only maintainers can accept the operational availability tradeoff and permanent trust boundary for credential-bearing repair publication.

options.title: Prove exact head and accept
options.body: Rerun the hosted containment, descendant-reaping, package-manager, and isolated publication scenarios on 7db879393087dbedf1a3e945cf1053651a75b1ca, then merge with the Linux/Landlock contract documented.

options.title: Split publication from containment
options.body: Land immutable commit publication and isolated authenticated Git first, then review the broader command-containment and package-manager restrictions in a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Pause for runner compatibility
options.body: Keep the PR open while defining a supported fallback or runner migration plan if the active repair fleet cannot consistently provide the required kernel features.

recommendation.title: Prove exact head and accept
